chat.author: Steven Riedl
chat.text: Steps 4 through 6 hinge on 'the Start Group': you wait for it on the new track, cut the old one at Largest Object, and deliver from it. In Aligned mode that hand-off is only seamless if Group N means the same media time range on both tracks and both put a boundary there. We produce exactly that by construction and can't declare it, so two asks: state that invariant as what Aligned promises, and give the subscriber a way to learn it before it sends SWITCH_FROM.

chat.author: Gwendal Simon
chat.text: FILL_TIMEOUT It is the maximum total duration in milliseconds a relay SHOULD spend waiting for upstream sources to provide Objects that are not immediately available before reporting them as Timed-Out gaps in the FETCH response.
